cd /workspace/project && python3 << 'EOF'
import paramiko
client = paramiko.SSHClient()
client.set_missing_host_key_policy(paramiko.AutoAddPolicy())
client.connect("46.202.154.25", 22, "root", "2N00py123+++")
# Check what files exist in game-data/world
stdin, stdout, stderr = client.exec_command("ls -la /opt/areloria/game-data/world/ 2>/dev/null || ls -la /opt/areloria/world/ | head -10")
print("World dir:", stdout.read().decode()[:500])
# Create client config if missing
stdin, stdout, stderr = client.exec_command("ls /opt/areloria/game-data/world/are-performance-policy.json 2>/dev/null || echo 'NOT FOUND'")
print("Config:", stdout.read().decode())
client.close()
EOF
